description: Example cell-type matching rules for find_regulatory_resources.py --synonyms. Copy this file and edit it for your cell type. 'synonyms': query alias (lowercased, matched as a substring of --cell-type) -> [term_name, ontology_id] pairs the IGVF/ENCODE portals use (ontology_id may be empty). 'tier_rules': optional sub-tiers inside the curated-synonym band, tried in order against the candidate's term_name and then its cell_slims; scores must stay between 50 and 90 and be >= 3 apart. 'tissue_rule': optional lower tier for tissue biosamples only. Tier rules apply only when the query matched a synonym alias.
